Subject: Phase 2: Backend Core Architecture
Description:
Establish the core backend architecture using NestJS and Hexagonal Architecture principles.

# High-Level Design (HLD)
- NestJS framework with TypeScript
- Hexagonal Architecture (Domain, Ports, Adapters)
- Event-driven communication via Redis Pub/Sub
- REST API for management and control
- WebSocket for real-time events
- Authentication and Authorization (JWT, RBAC)
- Database integration with TypeORM/Prisma
- Validation and Error Handling

# Architecture Decisions
- Domain logic must be pure TypeScript (no NestJS dependencies)
- Adapters handle external concerns (DB, Redis, Telephony)
- Ports define interfaces for adapters
- Use NestJS modules for feature isolation
- Centralized error handling and logging

# Deliverables
- packages/backend/src/domain (Pure TS)
- packages/backend/src/ports (Interfaces)
- packages/backend/src/adapters (Implementations)
- packages/backend/src/application (Use cases)
- packages/backend/src/infrastructure (NestJS modules)
- API documentation (Swagger)
- Unit and integration tests
